test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 21 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: On 9 May 2025, Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman directed banks to stay fully alert and ready in light of which specific situation?

options.text: Implementation of a new banking tax
Launch of a digital-only banking model
Heightened geopolitical tensions near border regions

solution:
The correct answer is __**Heightened geopolitical tensions near border regions**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• On **May 9, 2025**, Union Finance Minister **Nirmala Sitharaman** chaired a high-level review meeting with the **Managing Directors** and **CEOs** of **Public Sector Banks (PSBs)** in **New Delhi**.
 
• The meeting was specifically convened to discuss the banking sector's preparedness in the face of **heightened geopolitical tensions** particularly near **border regions**, which pose a unique set of challenges to financial infrastructure and national security.
 
• The **Finance Minister** directed banks to remain **fully alert** and develop robust **contingency plans** to ensure that banking operations, including **ATM services** and **digital payments**, remain uninterrupted in sensitive geographical zones. ***Hence, the situation related to border tensions is the primary reason for the directive.***
 
• Banks were instructed to prioritize the financial needs of the **Indian Armed Forces** and the civilian population residing in **strategic border areas** to maintain economic morale and stability.</
